title: Screen and machine learning find RNA binding proteins that boost circular RNA translation
summary: A cell-based screen identified 68 RNA binding proteins as putative activators of IRES-mediated noncanonical translation of circular RNAs. A machine-learning algorithm extracted common sequence features of these activators and predicted additional candidates, and both newly identified and predicted activators were validated to promote circRNA translation in a context-dependent manner. Machine learning is secondary to the experimental screen, and effects depend on context.
